hero.title: Hear life again,
hero.lead: Complete hearing assessments, tailored medical support and discreet devices to enjoy clear conversations with the people you love.

offer.body: Video otoscopy, pure-tone and speech audiometry, personalised diagnosis and fitting advice with Edith Kingue.

services.title: Our specialised audiology services
services.lead: Medical and technological solutions to protect, restore and improve your hearing health.

items.title: Complete hearing assessment & screening
items.description: Otoscopy, tympanometry, pure-tone and speech audiometry in a soundproof booth to measure your hearing thresholds precisely.

items.title: Custom hearing-aid fitting
items.description: Digital hearing aids chosen for your hearing profile, ear shape and everyday professional or family life.

items.title: Tuning, repair & maintenance
items.description: Ultrasonic cleaning, filter replacement and frequency recalibration in our Douala laboratory.

items.title: Unlimited personalised follow-up
items.description: We refine your settings over time and monitor how your hearing evolves, without rushing.

items.title: Tinnitus relief
items.description: Habituation protocols, sound therapy and personalised acoustic masking for calmer nights.

items.title: Custom hearing protection
items.description: Anatomical earplugs for industry, music, swimming and demanding sound environments.

science.title: Scientific rigour, with human empathy
science.body: Hearing loss isolates people gradually. Our mission is to restore your peace of mind with precise measurements, discreet technology and sincere listening.

pillars.title: Human listening & empathy
pillars.description: Every session respects your pace, habits and acoustic experience.

pillars.title: High-precision measurements
pillars.description: Computerised audiometric equipment for adjustments accurate to the decibel.

pillars.title: International technologies
pillars.description: Phonak, Oticon, Signia and Starkey with support and warranty.

pillars.title: Accessible clinic in Douala
pillars.description: In Kotto Briquiny, with parking and senior-friendly reception.

tech.imageAlt: Discreet rechargeable hearing aids at the Empire Audition clinic
tech.title: Acoustic excellence, almost imperceptible
tech.body: Modern devices separate voices from background noise and adapt automatically to your environment.
tech.feature1Small: Custom-moulded to the millimetre for total discretion.
tech.feature2Small: A full day of listening without handling batteries.
tech.feature3Small: Clearer voices at restaurants, in meetings or in traffic.
